replies.if_they_say: How much does this cost per month?
replies.reply: Monthly plans range from INR 1,499 to 3,999 depending on how many articles you need, and you pay only after you approve the work. Quick question: what are 2 or 3 questions your customers ask most often?

replies.if_they_say: Do you write for my type of business?
replies.reply: Yes. The posts focus on answering the exact questions your customers ask before buying, which works for almost any business. What kind of business do you run, and do you already have a website?

replies.if_they_say: I don't have time to manage a writer or give briefs.
replies.reply: Totally understandable. You don't need to write briefs or review endless drafts. You can just drop a quick voice note with the questions people ask, and I handle the research and writing. What is one question you get asked every week?
